assets.cat-sprites.png: Use-case: stylized-concept. Generate a production sprite atlas for Bravios, matching the polished hand-painted cartoon style, bold clean dark outlines and warm shaded colors of the two reference hero sheets. References are STYLE ONLY, do not include boys. Subject: one actual adorable orange tabby kitten, four paws, green eyes, cream muzzle and chest, pink collar with tiny gold bell, expressive tail. Not a human in a costume. Transparent background with real alpha, no scenery, shadows, lettering, labels, panels or grid lines. EXACT regular 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equally sized square cells. Each sprite fully contained with generous transparent margins, consistent character proportions and right-facing SIDE VIEW. Row 1 left to right: standing idle on four paws; running contact pose A; running passing pose B; running contact pose C. Row 2: running passing pose D; leaping upward with tucked rear paws; falling with paws extended forward/down; crouched landing on four paws. Consistent side profile, same kitten identity in all eight cells. Production game cutouts, readable when rendered at 36 pixels tall.
assets.dino-sprites.png: Use-case: stylized-concept. Generate a production sprite atlas for Bravios matching the polished hand-painted cartoon style, bold clean dark outlines and warm shaded colors of the two reference hero sheets. References are STYLE ONLY, do not include boys. One friendly rideable green dinosaur, rounded big head on the RIGHT, cream belly, small teal plates along tail and neck, large cheerful eyes. Biped with two rear legs and small arms. Crucially a broad fairly horizontal LOWER BACK with a small warm brown saddle centered over the hind legs, leaving an obvious place for a child rider; saddle should be LOWER than the head, at about 45% sprite height. Tail extends LEFT. Transparent background with real alpha, no scenery, no shadows, no lettering, no labels, no panels or grid lines. EXACT regular 2 columns x 2 rows, four equally sized square cells. All sprites fully contained with transparent margins, matching proportions and right-facing side view. Row 1: standing idle; walking contact pose left foot forward. Row 2: walking opposite contact pose; jumping with bent legs. Same head, tail and saddle position throughout. No rider in this atlas. Readable at 36 pixels tall. The dinosaur fits the existing platformer scale, cartoon friendly original dinosaur design.
assets.rider-sprites.png: Use-case: identity-preserve. Generate TWO transparent production game sprites using references 1 and 2 as exact character identity/outfit references. LEFT: Boaz from image 1, blue eyes blond hair, blue scarf, blue shirt, navy shorts, brown gloves boots backpack gold star brooch. RIGHT: Ravi from image 2, blue eyes blond hair, red scarf, cream shirt brown vest, green shorts, brown gloves boots backpack gold star brooch. Keep faces, hair, clothing, colors, outlined hand-painted cartoon style from references. Change only POSE to sitting astride an invisible dinosaur saddle: torso upright, facing RIGHT in side / slight three-quarter view, hips seated, thighs forward approximately horizontal, knees bent down, visible boot hangs down. Hands held naturally in front holding an invisible pommel. Both must clearly be SITTING rather than standing or crouching; no saddle, no dinosaur, no mount in image. Real alpha transparent background. EXACT regular 2 columns x 1 row with two equally sized square cells, one whole seated boy centered per cell with generous margin. Same scale and seating baseline in both cells. No captions, labels, borders, background, scenery, motion marks or ground shadows.
